look: Tempest Dragon, a SS-rank GKOM variant from the Stormglass Drakes family: four-legged tempest dragon wreathed in a living thunderhead, crystal scales ringing. Family anatomy: dragons and wyverns with storm-glass scales crackling with lightning. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: sealed in GKOM crystal except its eyes, open mouth interior and core; the crystals are storm-blue glass crystal. Element Lightning: electric yellow, cyan and indigo accents, elaborate layered branching arcs, static sparks and crackling halos
